verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented public API for programmatically driving macOS. 'Automate tasks with Shortcuts' is a user-facing automation feature, and the community mentions of built-in CLI utilities (pbcopy, qlmanage, hidutil) are individual tools rather than a documented API, so both are adjacent. Probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, and markdown docs all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
